title: Act: Add art sources, generateAssets and mergeManifest
summary: Create sources registry and pure generation functions
description: Add game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts with the ArtSource type and one seed hand-cursor source, and game/frontend/src/lib/generateAssets.ts with generateAssets and mergeManifest.
acceptance_criteria: generateAssets returns bytes and a valid entry per source
mergeManifest replaces by id and keeps others
technical_constraints: Indices come from the shared PALETTE of at most 48 colours

steps.action: Export interface ArtSource {id:string; path:string; frames: number[][][]} and ART_SOURCES array holding one source id 'ui/cursor-hand', path 'ui/cursors/hand.png', one 16x16 frame of palette indices (0 transparent-free background index 0, hand outline index 36, fill index 29).
steps.expected: ART_SOURCES has length 1 with a 16x16 frame

steps.action: Export generateAssets(sources, palette=PALETTE) returning {files:{path,bytes}[], entries:ManifestEntry[]}: map frames through gridToRgba, buildSpriteSheet, encodePng; entry is {id,path,type:'spritesheet',dimensions,frames:{frameWidth,frameHeight,frameCount}} when frameCount>1 else {id,path,type:'image',dimensions}.
steps.expected: Entries match the sheet size and frame count

steps.action: Export mergeManifest(manifest:{version:number;assets:ManifestEntry[]}, entries) returning a new manifest where an entry with the same id replaces the old in place and unmatched entries are appended; other assets unchanged.
